description: Provider-neutral public tool catalogue. Supply a public slot catalogue with capacities separately. No grader fields belong in an agent observation.

tools.name: create_booking
tools.description: Create a booking. Timeout may mean the write committed. Reuse the same idempotency key for retries of the same intent; a changed payload with a used key is rejected.

tools.name: cancel_booking
tools.description: Cancel an existing booking while preserving its record. Cancelling an already cancelled booking succeeds without changing state.

tools.name: move_booking
tools.description: Atomically move an active booking to another slot. Preserve its ID and old slot if the move fails. Timeout may hide a committed move.

tools.name: list_bookings
tools.description: Read booking records, including cancelled ones. With no customer filter, returns all synthetic booking records.

tools.name: get_operation
tools.description: Read the original successful response for an idempotency key. not_found means no success is recorded for that key.
